ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Screen all direct and indirect shareholders, directors, authorized signatories, UBOs and key counterparties against Spanish and EU restrictive measures, United Nations Security Council lists, politically exposed person data under Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree 304/2014, adverse media, insolvency, litigation and enforcement databases. OFAC screening is not generally mandatory under Spanish law without a United States nexus, but is commercially prudent for US-dollar payments, US persons, US banks, Stripe or other US-linked payment rails. PEP matches require senior-management approval, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, enhanced monitoring and documented risk assessment. Sanctions matches require immediate escalation, transaction suspension where legally required and no circumvention through nominees or intermediaries.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central, official denomination certification service: https://www.rmc.es and the official registrars portal at https://sede.registradores.org
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be expressed in a form acceptable to the Spanish Commercial Registry and must include or be compatible with the legal-form indication 'Sociedad Limitada', 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or 'S.L.'. Names must be sufficiently distinctive from existing registered or reserved names and must not create confusion, imply an unrelated activity, or use prohibited official or regulated references. Foreign-language names and transliterations may be accepted if they comply with uniqueness and public-order requirements. The corporate name does not replace any mandatory Spanish trade-name, product, medical-device or trademark registration.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Medical terms or regulated-profession references implying authorization not held by the applicant
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered or reserved company name
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: File a denomination certificate application with the Registro Mercantil Central using up to five proposed names, supported by applicant identification and, where applicable, foreign corporate authority. Upon approval, use the certificate for incorporation before a Spanish notary. The certificate generally supports execution of the deed within three months from issuance, while the denomination reservation may remain effective for up to six months; confirm the operative date on the issued certificate. If rejected, obtain the stated cause, revise the proposed names and resubmit. A formal administrative challenge may be filed with the competent registry authority under the applicable Commercial Registry procedural rules; after a registrar qualification decision, request reconsideration or file an appeal with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within the statutory period stated in the decision, commonly one month for a governmental appeal. Registry appeals do not cure a substantive conflict, prohibited term or trademark infringement risk.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A Spanish Sociedad Limitada must have a registered office in Spain under the Companies Law. A serviced or virtual office may be acceptable for registry purposes if it is a genuine address capable of receiving legal notices and maintaining corporate records, and if the provider permits lawful access and inspection. It is not sufficient for a regulated medical-device manufacturing or distribution business where the entity requires demonstrable premises, quality-management records, equipment, storage, traceability and regulatory access. Clear aligner sheets and automated trimming may trigger obligations under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 on medical devices, Spanish Royal Decree 192/2023 on medical devices and applicable AEMPS requirements. A manufacturing, importer, distributor or fulfillment address should therefore be physically suitable and consistent with the declared activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No official national probability is published. Qualitative operational risk is low for a passive holding or professional-services company, medium for a payment-active operating company, and medium to high for a dental medical-device manufacturer, importer or distributor. For this activity, an indicative non-statutory planning estimate is 5-15% annual probability of an unannounced or short-notice physical or documentary inspection, increasing materially where AEMPS, customs, product-safety, tax, labor, environmental or AML risk indicators exist.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Consolidated Text of the Capital Companies Law (Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio), Book I, arts. 20-23 (S.L.), 52-65 (capital), 94-111 (incorporation procedure); Commercial Registry Regulation (RD 1784/1996), arts. 88-126.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Central Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central) for name certification and Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil territorial) for legal registration under the Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (escritura pública de constitución) filed with a Spanish notary and subsequently registered in the Provincial Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: SL minimum share capital is EUR 3,000 (approx. USD 3,270) fully subscribed and paid in cash at execution of the public deed. No escrow account is required by law, but payment must be evidenced by a banker's certificate (certificado de depósito), and funds remain restricted until registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the founding members of the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada: FIRST: approve the incorporation of the company and fix the share capital at EUR 3,000, consisting of 3,000 participations of EUR 1 par value each, fully subscribed and paid in cash. SECOND: adopt the registered office at Calle Velázquez 123, 28001 Madrid, Spain, within the jurisdiction of the Mercantile Registry of Madrid. THIRD: appoint [Full Name] as Administrator-Manager and [Full Name] as Company Secretary, with joint authority to bind the company. FOURTH: authorize the Administrator to execute the public deed, obtain the provisional NIF, register the company, and initiate industrial and environmental licensing procedures for the thermoforming of dental clear aligner sheets.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central) via online platform or any Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a request for a negative name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social) giving at least three alternative corporate names. The Registry verifies that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to any existing or reserved name and issues a certificate for one alternative. The certificate is valid for three months (renewable once for an additional three months) and must be entered in the public deed.
required_dossiers: Completed application form specifying three name alternatives
Power of attorney or identity documents of the applicant founder
Proof of payment of the administrative fee (approx. EUR 20)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is denied because the name is not available, refile with fresh alternatives; if the Registry rejects a name improperly, submit a written challenge to the Central Mercantile Registry's director and provide a comparative list of registered names.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Capital Deposit Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution authorized by the Bank of Spain
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary account in the name of the company in formation (S.L. en formación) and deposit the legal minimum capital of EUR 3,000. Obtain a bank certificate stating the account holder, deposit date, and amount, since the notary must see evidence of effective payment before execution of the deed.
required_dossiers: Preliminary draft of the bylaws/estatutos
Identity document and tax ID of each founding shareholder
Money-laundering prevention forms (due diligence questionnaire)
Proof of legal representation if a corporate shareholder participates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes additional KYC requirements, submit certified tax residence certificates and corporate ownership chart; if the deposit certificate is defective, request a corrected certificate before notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation before a Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish notary (Notario) chosen by the founders; General Council of the Notary Profession
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the notary with the name certificate, bank deposit certificate, and draft bylaws. The notary verifies the legality of the corporate purpose, capital structure, and governance provisions. The deed must include identity of subscribers, corporate name, registered office, corporate purpose, share capital breakdown, articles of association, and appointment of administrators. The notary must also apply for the provisional NIF statutorily through the AEAT's electronic system.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate
Bank certificate of capital deposit
Draft articles of association (estatutos)
Original and photocopy of identity documents of all subscribers
Banker's certificate of payment of the share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies an illegal or ambiguous clause, amend the bylaws by means of a supplementary agreement or execute a corrective deed. If capital deposit is insufficient, replenish the account and obtain an updated certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Provisional NIF and Tax Census Filing (AEAT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria, AEAT) — Form 036/037
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After execution of the deed but before registration with the Mercantile Registry, the companies in formation must obtain a provisional corporate tax ID number (NIF provisional) and enroll in the census of entrepreneurs. File Form 036, marking the relevant IAE activities (IV.941.5 Medical and dental instruments) and the main activity. The notary generally files this telematic form at the time of the deed.
required_dossiers: Certified copy or original of the public deed
Form 036 signed by the legal representative
Identity document and power of attorney of the representative
Proof of domicile and intended industrial establishment address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT refuses the provisional NIF or returns the form due to inconsistencies, correct the error and refile; if the refusal is based on defects, provide the notarial copy and a legal certificate of incorporation intent. The provisional NIF may be used to open bank accounts and sign contracts subject to final registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Public Deed in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry of Madrid (Registro Mercantil de Madrid) under the Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver an authorized first copy (copia autorizada) of the public deed to the registry together with the provisional NIF certificate. The registrar examines the legal validity and, if no defects exist, enters the company in the Mercantile Registry. The company acquires a separate legal personality as of this registration. The registry will order publication of the incorporation data in the Official Gazette (BORME) and will return the registration certificate. The provisional NIF becomes definite automatically upon registry filing.
required_dossiers: Authorized copy of the notarial deed
Negative name certificate if not expired
Form 036 receipt with the provisional NIF
Proof of payment of the registration fee
Any prior administrative certificates requested by the registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a written defect or suspension, cure the defect through a supplementary notarial resolution and resubmit; appeal the decision to the Directorate-General for Legal Certainty and Public Faith (Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública) within two months if the refusal is unfounded. Ensure the name certificate is renewed if it expires during processing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in BORME, Final NIF and Notification to Statistics Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Official Gazette of the Mercantile Registry (Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil, BORME) and National Statistics Institute (INE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, the Registry transmits the incorporation details to BORME for mandatory public disclosure. The company's definitive NIF certificate can be downloaded from the AEAT website. File any statistical survey (if selected), and verify that the BORME announcement matches the deed data. This step completes the statutory formation process and enables industrial licensing proceedings.
required_dossiers: Mercantile Registry registration certificate
Definitive NIF certificate (downloaded)
No additional filing if registry has published BORME entry automatically
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the BORME entry contains an error, request rectification from the Mercantile Registry within ten days; if the definitive NIF is not generated due to tax file issues, contact AEAT at www.agenciatributaria.gob.es and cure the discrepancy.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Tourism (Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo) coordinated with the relevant Autonomous Community's Regional Industry Directorate and the municipality of registered office for the industrial activity license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Municipal de Apertura / Industrial Activity Operating License (start-up declaration under the applicable autonomous community regulation and Law 21/1992 on industrial activities).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Regional Ministry for the Environment (Consejería de Medio Ambiente) and the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (MITECO) in accordance with Law 21/2013 of 9 December on Environmental Assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration category (Actividad Potencialmente Contaminadora de la Atmosfera, ROPA) for small/medium thermoforming operations; full environmental impact assessment (EIA) is required only if production exceeds the Annex II threshold under Law 21/2013, i.e., polymer processing capacity of more than 200 tonnes per year or industrial sites larger than 1 ha.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to the municipal system must comply with pH 5.5-9.0, COD ≤750 mg/L, BOD5 ≤400 mg/L, TSS ≤350 mg/L, and contain no priority hazardous substances; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from thermoforming and trimming shall not exceed 50 mg C/Nm³ and fugitive VOC concentration shall be controlled by extraction and HEPA filtration; all plastic waste, polymer scrapping, and maintenance solvents must be transferred under an e-SIR traceability system to an authorized waste manager, and oils/grease separators must be installed to prevent oil pollution of the sewage network.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety compliance with the Technical Building Code (CTE DB-SI), requiring municipal fire certification, emergency routes, extinguishers, and alarm system; structural inspection certificate of building loads and seismic suitability signed by a competent architect or technical engineer; occupational risk-prevention plan under Law 31/1995, coordination with the autonomous labor authority, and clearance of workplaces for machinery operation, including noise evaluation (LDEN ≤80 dBA) and hygienic working conditions for clean-water and dental-material handling.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), official portal https://www.aeat.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities seeking to operate in Spain must procure a NIF by filing an application with the AEAT via their online portal or through a tax advisor. Mandatory documents include the foreign company's incorporation certificate, passport of representatives, and proof of Spanish address if applicable. The process typically takes 10-20 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not offer check-the-box elections. Limited hybrid mismatch elections may apply under EU directives, but standard SL entities are subject to entity-level corporate taxation without elective regimes for tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 50,000 EUR annual turnover threshold for mandatory registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) for all B2B transactions since 2023, with real-time reporting to the AEAT's Registro de Facturación system. Digital stamps and API integrations required for clearance and compliance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated VAT (0%) for goods exported outside the EU, subject to proof of export and non-reintroduction into the EU. Offshore services may qualify under specific intra-EU or third-country rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Proof of delivery to third country
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims result in penalties of 100% of the evaded VAT plus interest and potential criminal liability. Retrospective clawback applies if export documentation is not substantiated within the audit period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain maintains full convertibility for both current and capital accounts under EU and IMF standards. Resident shareholders may remit profits freely. Non-resident distributions are subject to 15% withholding tax and beneficial ownership verification. No material remittance restrictions apply to standard corporate treasury operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Foreign-currency export receipts must be repatriated and surrendered to an authorized Spanish bank within one year of shipment. Mandatory conversion to EUR upon deposit; no statutory conversion ratio applies. Export declarations filed via Ventanilla Única; supporting documentation retained for regulatory audits.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for cross-border payments through licensed EMI providers (e.g., N26 Business, Revolut Business) provided full Spanish AML/KYC compliance and Banco de España registration are maintained. Offshore digital EMIs face restrictions on certain high-risk transaction types.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of directors and authorized signatories is mandatory for initial corporate KYC onboarding and identity verification at Spanish commercial banks. Remote account opening is not permitted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, director identification documents, ownership structure diagram, and source-of-funds evidence
Enhanced due diligence reports and Registro Mercantil legal-entity verification

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital via SWIFT MT103 to Spanish IBAN accounts. Required purpose code: 'Capital contribution' or 'Aportación de capital'. Bank confirmation of source of funds and beneficial ownership required. SEPA transfers applicable for intra-EU movements.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements via SWIFT MT103 or commercial letters of credit. All transactions supported by trade documentation and compliance with export/import regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalisation of accounting books, including the journal and inventory and annual accounts book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Mercantile Registry of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of each financial year; generally by 30 April for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No standard automatic fine; possible evidentiary and administrative consequences, inspection exposure, and inability to rely fully on properly legalised books. Registry filing tariffs may apply and vary by registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts by the shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting; corporate records maintained by the company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of the financial year; generally by 30 June for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Director liability risk for breach of statutory duties and potential penalties or claims arising from delayed approval or inaccurate accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of approved annual accounts and required corporate documents
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Mercantile Registry of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after shareholder approval; generally by 31 July for accounts approved on 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines generally ranging from EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000, with higher limits for companies exceeding EUR 6 million in annual turnover; registry closure may occur after one year from expiry of the filing period, subject to statutory exceptions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership statement accompanying the annual accounts filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Mercantile Registry and the Central Register of Beneficial Ownership through the prescribed registry process
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted with the annual accounts; updated when beneficial ownership information changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Filing defects may prevent completion of the annual accounts filing and may trigger registry, anti-money-laundering, and director-liability consequences.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the end of the tax period; generally 1 to 25 July for a calendar-year company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing without tax due may incur a graduated surcharge or fixed penalty; late payment may incur surcharges and interest. Underpayment or failure to file may trigger tax assessment, penalties, and late-payment interest.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholder meeting minutes and corporate minute-book update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company records; available to the Mercantile Registry, tax authorities, and other competent authorities upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least annually, including the meeting approving the annual accounts; record promptly in the minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Director liability and corporate governance evidence risks; deficiencies may impair the validity or evidentiary value of corporate resolutions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent statutory audit is generally mandatory when the company exceeds at least two of the following thresholds for two consecutive financial years: total assets above EUR 2.85 million, annual net turnover above EUR 5.7 million, or average workforce above 50 employees. Mandatory audit also applies in specified cases, including certain regulated or public-interest entities, companies issuing securities admitted to trading, and other statutory circumstances.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish Generally Accepted Accounting Principles under the Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad), with applicable adaptations for SMEs and other regulated sectors. IFRS is principally mandatory for consolidated accounts of listed groups and may apply in other legally specified circumstances.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must identify and maintain current beneficial ownership information. The annual accounts filing includes the required beneficial ownership declaration or confirmation. A no-change confirmation is made where applicable; changes in ultimate beneficial ownership must be updated through the prescribed Mercantile Registry and beneficial ownership reporting process without waiting for the next annual filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors and Directors' Powers
Register of Contracts with the Sole Shareholder, where the company has a sole shareholder

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 325-1,300 per year for a registered office and basic corporate administration service; higher for mail handling, nominee support, or expanded secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 1,500-6,000 for a small Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada subject to statutory audit; complex, regulated, or group audits may cost materially more

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% for new companies on the first €300,000 of taxable base for the first two years of profit; additional tax credits for R&D and innovation activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) filed electronically via the AEAT (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria) online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days following the 6 months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g., for calendar year-end, by July 25).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number (NIF) of the entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Spanish NIF assigned to the non-resident entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year start and end dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate the tax period covered by the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover (importe neto de la cifra de negocios).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross revenue from sales of dental aligner sheets, net of returns and discounts.
Apply Spanish GAAP adjustments and transfer pricing corrections if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits and deductions (deducciones y bonificaciones).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim R&D credits or other incentives; attach supporting documentation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax due, increasing by 1% per month of delay, up to 20%; plus daily surcharge of €200 per day for non-submission after formal request. Interest on late payment accrues at the statutory rate.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced withholding under a tax treaty, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from its home tax authority and submit it to the Spanish paying entity. The payer must file Form 210 (or relevant) with the AEAT to apply the treaty rate. The TRC must be valid for the fiscal year of the dividend distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 24%, treaty-reduced typically 10% (e.g., under OECD-based treaties). Interest: statutory 19%, treaty-reduced typically 10%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 10,000,000 net turnover (mandatory Local File and Master File preparation).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain applies anti-abuse and substance-over-form rules. No specific Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) as in offshore jurisdictions, but tax residency requires real management and operational substance. Treaty benefits may be denied if the entity lacks economic substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income, false invoicing, or concealment of assets in the dental aligner manufacturing operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 50% to 150% of the tax evaded, plus interest. Criminal prosecution for amounts exceeding €120,000 per year may result in imprisonment of 1 to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid corporate taxes if they knowingly participated in the evasion. Travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a mere conduit with no real economic activity, employees, or physical presence in Spain, while claiming tax benefits or treaty relief.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of tax treaty benefits, recharacterization of transactions, and imposition of a 25% penalty on the underpaid tax. The company may be deemed a tax resident of another jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for taxes and penalties if they used the shell structure to evade tax. Travel bans and restrictions on leaving Spain may be applied.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML controls, accepting cash payments above €10,000, or failing to report suspicious transactions related to the sale of dental aligner sheets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €150,000 for serious infractions, and up to €1,500,000 for very serious infractions. Criminal liability for money laundering can lead to imprisonment of 6 months to 6 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally fined and imprisoned if they knowingly facilitate money laundering. They may also face disqualification from holding corporate office.
